items.meaning: RTSP establishes and controls either a single or several time-synchronized streams of continuous media such as audio and video.
Interleaving of the continuous media stream with the control stream is possible.
There is no notion of an RTSP connection.
A server maintains a session labeled by an identifier.
An RTSP session is in no way tied to a transport-level connection such as a TCP connection.
During an RTSP session, an RTSP client may open and close many reliable transport connections to the server to issue RTSP requests.
An RTSP client may use a connectionless transport protocol such as UDP.
The streams controlled by RTSP may use RTP.
The operation of RTSP does not depend on the transport mechanism used to carry continuous media.
The protocol is intentionally similar in syntax and operation to HTTP/1.1.
Extension mechanisms to HTTP can in most cases also be added to RTSP.
RTSP differs in a number of important aspects from HTTP.
客户端可以通过 HTTP 或其他方法请求呈现描述（presentation description）。
当呈现以组播方式发送时，呈现描述包含连续媒体所用的组播地址和端口。
items.condition: If the presentation is being multicast

items.meaning: 当呈现仅以单播方式发送给客户端时，客户端出于安全原因提供目的地址。
items.condition: If the presentation is to be sent only to the client via unicast

items.meaning: 媒体服务器可以被“邀请”加入已有会议，以便向呈现中回放媒体，或录制呈现中全部或部分媒体。
特别是在直播呈现中，服务器能够告知客户端有额外媒体变为可用是有用的。
items.condition: Particularly for live presentations

items.meaning: RTSP 请求可以像 HTTP/1.1 那样由代理、隧道和缓存处理。
文档中的 MUST、MUST NOT、REQUIRED、SHALL、SHALL NOT、SHOULD、SHOULD NOT、RECOMMENDED、MAY、OPTIONAL 等关键词须按 RFC 2119 所述解释。
items.constraint: The key words MUST, MUST NOT, REQUIRED, SHALL, SHALL NOT, SHOULD, SHOULD NOT, RECOMMENDED, MAY, and OPTIONAL in this document are to be interpreted as described in RFC 2119 [4].

items.meaning: 由服务器使用单一时间轴对多个流进行控制；对于音频/视频馈送，客户端可发出单个 play 或 pause 消息同时控制音频和视频馈送。
items.constraint: 对音频/视频馈送，客户端可发出单个 play 或 pause 消息以同时控制音频和视频馈送

items.meaning: 可包含多个媒体流的文件，这些流一起播放时通常构成一个呈现；RTSP 服务器可对这些文件提供聚合控制，但容器文件的概念并未嵌入协议中。
items.constraint: RTSP 服务器可对这些文件提供聚合控制，但容器文件的概念未嵌入协议

items.meaning: 源与宿之间存在定时关系的数据，即宿必须重现源处存在的定时关系；示例为音频与运动视频，并可为实时（交互）或流式（回放）。
items.constraint: 宿必须重现源处存在的定时关系

items.meaning: 数据类型/编解码器特定的初始化（如时钟频率、颜色表等）；客户端回放媒体流所需的任何传输无关信息出现在流建立的媒体初始化阶段。
items.constraint: 客户端回放媒体流所需的任何传输无关信息出现在流建立的媒体初始化阶段

items.meaning: 特定于某媒体类型的参数，可在流回放之前或期间被更改。
items.constraint: 可在流回放之前或期间被更改

items.meaning: The server providing playback or recording services for one or more media streams.
A single media instance, such as an audio stream, video stream, whiteboard, or shared application group.
A member of a conference; a participant may be a machine such as a media record or playback server.
A presentation description contains information about one or more media streams within a presentation.
An RTSP response; if an HTTP response is meant, that is indicated explicitly.
An RTSP request; if an HTTP request is meant, that is indicated explicitly.
RTSP reuses web security mechanisms, and HTTP authentication mechanisms such as basic and digest authentication are directly applicable.
HTTP authentication mechanisms such as basic and digest authentication are directly applicable to RTSP.
Transport or network layer security mechanisms may also be reused.
items.constraint: One may also reuse transport or network layer security mechanisms.
items.object: transport or network layer security mechanisms

items.meaning: RTSP may use an unreliable datagram protocol (UDP), a reliable datagram protocol (RDP), or a reliable stream protocol such as TCP as it implements application-level reliability.
RTSP may use an unreliable datagram protocol (UDP), a reliable datagram protocol (RDP), or a reliable stream protocol such as TCP as it implements application-level reliability.
items.constraint: RTSP may use either an unreliable datagram protocol (UDP), a reliable datagram protocol (RDP), or a reliable stream protocol such as TCP as it implements application-level reliability.
items.object: either an unreliable datagram protocol (UDP), a reliable datagram protocol (RDP), or a reliable stream protocol such as TCP
items.condition: as it implements application-level reliability

items.entity: Separation of stream control and conference initiation
items.meaning: Stream control is divorced from inviting a media server to a conference; the conference initiation protocol either provides or can be used to create a unique conference identifier.
The protocol does not impose a particular presentation description or metafile format and can convey the type of format to be used.
The presentation description must contain at least one RTSP URI.
items.constraint: the presentation description must contain at least one RTSP URI

items.meaning: 该协议应当能被应用层与传输层（SOCKS）防火墙顺利处理
items.constraint: should be readily handled by both application and transport-layer (SOCKS [14]) firewalls

items.meaning: 防火墙可能需要理解 SETUP 方法，以便为 UDP 媒体流开一个“洞”
items.constraint: A firewall may need to understand the SETUP method to open a "hole" for the UDP media stream

items.meaning: 如果客户端能启动流，它必须能够停止流
items.constraint: If a client can start a stream, it must be able to stop a stream
items.condition: If a client can start a stream

items.meaning: 服务器不应以客户端无法停止流的方式来向客户端启动流传输
items.constraint: Servers should not start streaming to clients in such a way that clients cannot stop the stream
items.object: to clients in such a way that clients cannot stop the stream

items.meaning: 若基本特性被禁用，必须有干净的机制让客户端确定哪些方法不会被实现
items.constraint: If basic features are disabled, there must be some clean mechanism for the client to determine which methods are not going to be implemented
items.object: for the client to determine which methods are not going to be implemented
items.condition: If basic features are disabled

items.meaning: 若不允许 seeking，用户界面必须能够禁止移动滑动位置指示器
items.constraint: if seeking is not allowed, the user interface must be able to disallow moving a sliding position indicator
items.condition: if seeking is not allowed

items.meaning: 服务器可能只具备播放能力，因而无需支持 RECORD 请求
items.constraint: A server may only be capable of playback thus has no need to support the RECORD request

items.meaning: 若只支持实时事件，服务器可能不具备定位（绝对定位）能力
items.constraint: A server may not be capable of seeking (absolute positioning) if it is to support live events only
items.condition: if it is to support live events only

items.meaning: 某些服务器可能不支持设置流参数，因而不支持 GET_PARAMETER 和 SET_PARAMETER
items.constraint: Some servers may not support setting stream parameters and thus not support GET_PARAMETER and SET_PARAMETER

items.meaning: 服务器应当实现第 12 节描述的所有头字段
items.constraint: A server SHOULD implement all header fields described in Section 12
items.object: all header fields described in Section 12

items.meaning: Existing methods can be extended with new parameters as long as those parameters can be safely ignored by the recipient.
A tag corresponding to a method extension may be added in the Require field when the client needs negative acknowledgement for an unsupported extension.
items.constraint: a tag corresponding to the extension may be added in the Require: field
items.object: a tag corresponding to the extension
items.condition: If the client needs negative acknowledgement when a method extension is not supported

items.meaning: New methods can be added.
If the recipient does not understand the request, it responds with error code 501 (Not implemented).
If the recipient does not understand the request, the sender should not attempt to use that method again.
items.constraint: the sender should not attempt to use this method again
items.condition: If the recipient of the message does not understand the request

items.meaning: A client may use the OPTIONS method to inquire about methods supported by the server.
items.constraint: A client may also use the OPTIONS method to inquire about methods supported by the server
items.object: the OPTIONS method to inquire about methods supported by the server

items.meaning: The server SHOULD list the methods it supports using the Public response header.
items.constraint: The server SHOULD list the methods it supports using the Public response header
items.object: the methods it supports using the Public response header

items.meaning: A new version of the protocol can be defined, allowing almost all aspects except the position of the protocol version number to change.
Each presentation and media stream may be identified by an RTSP URL.
items.constraint: Each presentation and media stream may be identified by an RTSP URL

items.meaning: The overall presentation and the properties of its media are defined by a presentation description file whose format is outside the scope of the specification.
The presentation description file may be obtained by the client using HTTP or other means such as email.
items.constraint: The presentation description file may be obtained by the client using HTTP or other means such as email

items.meaning: The presentation description file may not necessarily be stored on the media server.
A presentation description is assumed to describe one or more presentations, each maintaining a common time axis.
A presentation may contain several media streams.
items.constraint: A presentation may contain several media streams

items.meaning: Multicast mode in which the client chooses the address.

If the server is to participate in an existing multicast conference, the multicast address, port and encryption key are given by the conference description, established outside the scope of the specification.
RTSP 控制一个媒体流，而该流可以通过独立于控制通道的另一个协议来传输。
RTSP 控制可以发生在一条 TCP 连接上，而数据通过 UDP 传输。
即使媒体服务器没有收到 RTSP 请求，数据传输仍会继续。
在其生命周期内，单个媒体流可能受依次在不同 TCP 连接上发出的 RTSP 请求控制。
服务器需要维护“会话状态”，以便将 RTSP 请求与某个流关联起来。
状态转换在 Section A 中描述。
RTSP 在功能上与 HTTP 存在一定重叠。
表示描述可以使用 HTTP 或 RTSP 获取。
HTTP 是一种非对称协议，由客户端发出请求、服务器作出响应。
在 RTSP 中，媒体客户端和媒体服务器都可以发出请求。
RTSP 请求并非无状态；它们可以设置参数，并在很长时间内持续控制一个媒体流。
如果端口为空或未给出，则假定使用端口 554。
所标识的资源可以由 RTSP 在该主机的相应端口上监听 TCP 连接或 UDP 数据包的服务器处控制。
scheme “rtsp” 指 TCP 连接。
scheme “rtspu” 指 UDP 数据包。
该资源的 Request-URI 是 rtsp_URL。
The use of IP addresses in URLs should be avoided whenever possible.
items.constraint: The use of IP addresses in URLs SHOULD be avoided whenever possible.
items.object: use of IP addresses in URLs
items.condition: whenever possible

items.meaning: A presentation or a stream is identified by a textual media identifier using the character set and escape conventions of URLs.
URLs may refer to a stream or an aggregate of streams, i.e., a presentation.
Requests described in Section 10 can apply to either the whole presentation or an individual stream within the presentation.
Some request methods can only be applied to streams, not presentations, and vice versa.
The presentation 'twister' may be composed of audio and video streams.
This does not imply a standard way to reference streams in URLs.
The presentation description defines the hierarchical relationships in the presentation and the URLs for the individual streams.
A presentation description may name a stream 'a.mov' and the whole presentation 'b.mov'.
Conference identifiers are opaque to RTSP and are encoded using standard URI encoding methods, with LWS escaped with %.
The conference identifier must be globally unique.
items.constraint: The conference identifier MUST be globally unique.

items.meaning: For H.323, the conferenceID value is to be used.
会话标识符是任意长度的不透明字符串。
线性空白必须做 URL 转义。
items.constraint: Linear white space must be URL-escaped

items.meaning: 会话标识符必须随机选取，以增加猜中的难度。
items.constraint: A session identifier MUST be chosen randomly

items.meaning: 会话标识符长度必须至少八个八位组。
items.constraint: MUST be at least eight octets long
items.action: be at least eight octets long

items.meaning: SMPTE 相对时间戳表示相对于剪辑开始的时间。
其他 SMPTE 编码（如 SMPTE 25）可以通过替代使用 smpte time 来支持。
items.constraint: Other SMPTE codes MAY be supported (such as "SMPTE 25") through the use of alternative use of "smpte time"

items.meaning: SMPTE 范围语法规则：smpte-type "=" smpte-time "-" [ smpte-time ]。
SMPTE 类型取值："smpte" | "smpte-30-drop" | "smpte-25"。
SMPTE 时间语法：由时、分、秒及可选帧、可选小数部分构成。
正常播放时间指示流相对于呈现开始处的绝对位置。
特殊常量 now 定义为现场事件的当前时刻，只能用于现场事件。
items.constraint: It may be used only for live events
items.condition: only for live events

items.meaning: 观众与节目关联的时钟（normal play time），逻辑上等同于 SMPTE 时间码。
绝对时间用 ISO 8601 时间戳表示，使用 UTC（GMT）。
新的 RTSP 选项的创建者应为该选项加上反向域名前缀，或向 IANA 注册该新选项。
items.constraint: new RTSP option creator should prefix the option with a reverse domain name or register it with IANA
items.action: prefix the option with a reverse domain name or register the new option with IANA

items.meaning: 注册新的 RTSP 选项时应提供随后列出的信息。
items.constraint: the following information should be provided
items.condition: When registering a new RTSP option

items.meaning: 选项名可以是任意长度。
选项名长度不应超过二十个字符。
items.constraint: name SHOULD be no more than twenty characters long
items.action: be no more than twenty characters long

items.meaning: 选项名不得包含空格、控制字符或句点。
items.constraint: name MUST not contain any spaces, control characters or periods
items.object: any spaces, control characters or periods

items.entity: A reference to a further description
items.meaning: A reference to further description, if available, is one of the following in order of preference: an RFC, a published paper, a patent filing, a technical report, documented source code, or a computer manual.
For proprietary options, contact information (postal and email address) is provided.
RTSP is a text-based protocol and uses the ISO 10646 character set in UTF-8 encoding.
Lines are terminated by CRLF.
Receivers should be prepared to also interpret CR and LF by themselves as line terminators.
items.constraint: receivers should be prepared to also interpret CR and LF by themselves as line terminators
items.object: CR and LF by themselves as line terminators

items.meaning: Text-based protocols make it easier to add optional parameters in a self-describing manner and allow easy implementation of research prototypes in scripting languages such as Tcl, Visual Basic and Perl.
Requests contain methods, the object the method is operating upon, and parameters to further describe the method.
Methods are idempotent unless otherwise noted.
Methods are designed to require little or no state maintenance at the media server.
When a message body is included with a message, the length of that body is determined by one of the following in order of precedence.
响应消息（如1xx、204、304）不得包含消息体。
items.constraint: MUST NOT include a message body
items.condition: Any response message which MUST NOT include a message body (such as the 1xx, 204, and 304 responses)

items.meaning: 对于不得包含消息体的响应，在头部字段后由第一个空行终止。
items.constraint: always terminated by the first empty line after the header fields

items.meaning: 若存在，其字节值表示消息体长度；若不存在，则假定为零。
items.constraint: If present, value in bytes represents length of message-body; if absent, value zero is assumed

items.meaning: 服务器应始终能够确定返回的表示描述的时长。
items.constraint: should always be able to determine its length
items.condition: Given the moderate length of presentation descriptions returned

items.meaning: 如果存在任何实体主体，则必须存在Content-Length。
items.constraint: must be present if there is any entity body
items.condition: if there is any entity body

items.meaning: 在此上下文中，Pragma头未定义。
items.constraint: Pragma, Transfer-Encoding and Upgrade headers are not defined

items.meaning: 在此上下文中，Transfer-Encoding头未定义。
items.constraint: Pragma, Transfer-Encoding and Upgrade headers are not defined

items.meaning: 在此上下文中，Upgrade头未定义。
items.constraint: Pragma, Transfer-Encoding and Upgrade headers are not defined

items.meaning: ABNF产生式，枚举请求头字段Accept、Accept-Encoding、Accept-Language、Authorization、From、If-Modified-Since、Range、Referer、User-Agent。
items.constraint: request-header includes Accept, Accept-Encoding, Accept-Language, Authorization, From, If-Modified-Since, Range, Referer, User-Agent

items.meaning: Request-URI 中的星号 "*" 表示请求不针对特定资源而针对服务器本身。
items.constraint: the asterisk "*" ... is only allowed when the method used does not necessarily apply to a resource
items.condition: when the method used does not necessarily apply to a resource

items.meaning: HTTP 规范第 H6 节的规则适用，但将 HTTP-Version 替换为 RTSP-Version。
items.constraint: [H6] applies except that HTTP-Version is replaced by RTSP-Version

items.meaning: 有效的响应码及其可配合使用的方法定义在 Table 1 中。
Response 消息的第一行是 Status-Line，由协议版本、数字状态码和相关文本短语以 SP 分隔组成。
Status-Line 中除最后的 CRLF 外不允许出现 CR 或 LF。
items.constraint: No CR or LF is allowed except in the final CRLF sequence
items.keyword_raw: No CR or LF is allowed

items.meaning: Status-Code 是表示理解并满足请求尝试结果的 3 位整数结果码。
客户端不要求检查或显示 Reason-Phrase。
items.constraint: The client is not required to examine or display the Reason-Phrase

items.meaning: 1xx 表示信息性状态类：请求已收到，继续处理。
2xx 表示成功状态类：动作已被成功接收、理解并接受。
3xx 表示重定向状态类：为完成请求必须采取进一步动作。
items.constraint: Further action must be taken in order to complete the request
items.condition: in order to complete the request

items.meaning: 4xx 表示客户端错误状态类：请求包含错误语法或无法被满足。
5xx 表示服务器错误状态类：服务器未能满足看似有效的请求。
RTSP/1.0 状态码对应的原因短语仅为推荐，可用本地等价物替换而不影响协议。
RTSP 采用大多数 HTTP/1.1 状态码，并添加从 x50 开始的 RTSP 特定状态码以避免与新的 HTTP 状态码冲突。
RTSP 的 Status-Code 语法规则枚举了从 100 到 551 的三位状态码，并允许 extension-code。
Status-Code 规则允许 extension-code 作为扩展状态码。
RTSP 状态码是可扩展的。
RTSP 应用不要求理解所有已注册状态码的含义，尽管这种理解是可取的。
应用必须理解任何状态码的类别（由首位数字指示）。
items.constraint: MUST understand the class of any status code, as indicated by the first digit
items.object: the class of any status code, as indicated by the first digit

items.meaning: 应用必须将任何未识别响应视为该类别的 x00 状态码。
items.constraint: MUST treat any unrecognized response as being equivalent to the x00 status code of that class
items.object: any unrecognized response as being equivalent to the x00 status code of that class
items.exception: with the exception that an unrecognized response MUST NOT be cached

items.meaning: 未识别响应不得被缓存。
items.constraint: MUST NOT cache an unrecognized response

items.meaning: 在收到未识别状态码的情况下，用户代理应把响应中返回的实体呈现给用户。
items.constraint: SHOULD present to the user the entity returned with the response
items.object: the entity returned with the response
items.condition: In such cases

items.meaning: 示例：客户端收到未识别状态码 431 时，可安全地认为请求有问题并按 400 状态码处理。
状态码 412（Precondition Failed）适用于 DESCRIBE 和 SETUP 方法。
状态码 451（Invalid parameter）适用于 SETUP 方法。
状态码 452（Illegal Conference Identifier）适用于 SETUP 方法。
状态码 453（Not Enough Bandwidth）适用于 SETUP 方法。
状态码 457（Invalid Range）适用于 PLAY 方法。
状态码 458（Parameter Is Read-Only）适用于 SET_PARAMETER 方法。
状态码 551（Option not support）适用于所有方法（all）。

可出现在 response-header 中的字段，详见第 12.25 节
可出现在 response-header 中的字段，详见第 12.26 节

可出现在 response-header 中的字段，详见第 12.44 节
响应头字段名只有与协议版本变更结合时才能可靠地扩展
items.constraint: can be extended reliably only in combination with a change in the protocol version

items.meaning: 新的或实验性的头字段在通信各方都将其识别为响应头字段时可被赋予响应头字段的语义
items.constraint: new or experimental header fields MAY be given the semantics of response-header fields if all parties in the communication recognize them to be response-header fields
items.action: be given the semantics of response-header fields
items.condition: if all parties in the communication recognize them to be response-header fields

items.meaning: 未被识别的头字段被当作实体头(entity-header)字段处理
items.constraint: Unrecognized header fields are treated as entity-header fields

items.meaning: 请求与响应消息在未被请求方法或响应状态码另行限制时可以传输实体
items.constraint: Request and Response messages MAY transfer an entity if not otherwise restricted by the request method or response status code
items.condition: if not otherwise restricted by the request method or response status code

items.meaning: 实体头字段定义关于实体体（无实体体时关于请求所标识的资源）的可选元信息
扩展头机制允许在不改变协议的情况下定义额外的实体头字段，但不得假定接收方能够识别这些字段
未被识别的头字段应被接收方忽略并由代理转发
items.constraint: Unrecognized header fields SHOULD be ignored by the recipient and forwarded by proxies
items.action: ignored by the recipient and forwarded by proxies

items.meaning: 请求；支持持久连接或无连接模式的客户端 MAY 将请求流水线化发送（发送多个请求而不等待各自的响应）
items.constraint: 支持持久连接或无连接模式的客户端 MAY pipeline 请求
items.action: pipeline (send multiple requests without waiting for each response)
items.condition: A client that supports persistent connections or connectionless mode

items.meaning: 服务器；必须按请求接收的顺序发送对这些请求的响应
items.constraint: server MUST send responses in the same order requests were received
items.object: its responses to those requests in the same order that the requests were received

items.meaning: 请求由接收方确认，除非被发送到多播组
发送方；若无确认，可在超时一个往返时间（RTT）后重发同一消息
items.constraint: sender may resend the same message after a timeout of one RTT if there is no acknowledgement
items.object: the same message after a timeout of one round-trip time (RTT)
items.condition: If there is no acknowledgement

items.meaning: 往返时间按 TCP（RFC 1123）估计，初始往返值为 500 ms
实现可缓存最后一次 RTT 测量值作为未来连接的初始值
items.constraint: implementation MAY cache the last RTT measurement as the initial value for future connections
items.object: the last RTT measurement as the initial value for future connections

items.meaning: 若使用可靠传输协议承载 RTSP，则请求不得重传
items.constraint: requests MUST NOT be retransmitted when a reliable transport protocol is used
items.condition: If a reliable transport protocol is used to carry RTSP

items.meaning: RTSP 应用必须依赖底层传输提供可靠性
items.constraint: RTSP application MUST instead rely on the underlying transport to provide reliability

items.meaning: Clear ground rules need to be established so clients have an unambiguous means of knowing when to request media initialization information via DESCRIBE and when not to.

Media initialization is a requirement for any RTSP-based system, but the RTSP specification does not dictate that this must be done via the DESCRIBE method; there are three ways that an RTSP client may receive initialization information.
It is highly recommended that minimal servers support the DESCRIBE method and that minimal clients support acting as a helper application that accepts a media initialization file.

When sent from client to server, ANNOUNCE posts the description of a presentation or media object identified by the request URL to a server; when sent from server to client, ANNOUNCE updates the session description in real-time.
